title: Features

e A field in which you specify the new premise.

Features
You can use the following examples to identify which installation and point of delivery are identified and which data is reallocated.

Se Example

You have two installations that are allocated to a premise. Both installations have the same point of delivery:

Installation

A

Premise                         Premise
V_ALT                           V_ALT

“  a

Point of Delivery
ZP_XXX

Reallocate Point of Delivery/Installation to New Premise - Example 1

Identification

e If you specify installation A and a new premise V_NEU in transaction ES64, the system identifies installation A,
installation B and point of delivery ZP_XXX.

e If you specify installation B and a new premise V_NEU in transaction ES64, the system also identifies installation A,
installation B and point of delivery ZP_XXX.

e If you specify point of delivery ZP_XXX and a new premise V_NEU in transaction ES64, the system also identifies
installation A, installation B and point of delivery ZP_XXX.

Reallocation
